name.title: Bank name
name.description: Full or partial bank name to search for, e.g. "Wells Fargo" or "First National". Leave blank to browse by state instead.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to banks headquartered there, e.g. "TX". Leave blank for nationwide.

activeOnly.title: Active institutions only
activeOnly.description: Exclude closed, merged, or renamed institutions. Turn off to include historical records too.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of banks to return, largest total assets first.
